aldar-sei-saadiyat:2026-09-07-first-phas.body:
SEI SAADIYAT — FIRST SALES RELEASE

Aldar has announced Sei Saadiyat in Saadiyat Cultural District. Phase one brings 265 homes across two buildings, with 1–3 bedroom apartments and 2-bedroom lofts. Sales are scheduled to open on 16 September 2026.

Broker listings indicate prices from AED 2.95 million, a 50/50 plan and Q4 2030 handover; these commercial terms have not yet been confirmed in an accessible Aldar price list.

ellington-business-bay-offices:initial-p.body:
ELLINGTON · BUSINESS BAY OFFICES

BROKER INTELLIGENCE

Brokers are previewing a Grade-A office development in Business Bay, close to Sheikh Zayed Road, attributed to Ellington Properties.

An official project name, launch date, starting price and payment plan are not yet confirmed. An early-access opportunity to watch as formal details emerge.

ellington-al-yalayis:initial-prelaunch-r.body:
ELLINGTON · AL YALAYIS COMMUNITY

BROKER INTELLIGENCE

Brokers are promoting a large Ellington master community in Al Yalayis 1, with apartments, townhouses and villas.

The project’s official name, scale, prices, payment terms and launch timing have not yet been confirmed by Ellington. This remains an early-access lead rather than a confirmed sales launch.

marsa-al-saadiyat:2026-h2-first-sales-wi.body:
MARSA AL SAADIYAT · FIRST COLLECTION WATCH

Aldar has announced the AED 100 billion Marsa Al Saadiyat waterfront destination, the final major chapter of Saadiyat Island.

The first residential sales are planned for the second half of 2026. No named collection, starting price or payment plan has been released yet.

https://graf.ae/launches/marsa-al-saadiyat/

valia-dubai-creek-harbour:2026-08-31-sal.body:
VALIA — DUBAI CREEK HARBOUR

Emaar has launched Valia, a waterfront residential tower with 1–4 bedroom apartments. Emaar's official page confirms prices from AED 1.96 million.

Current broker material indicates an 80/20 payment plan and Q4 2030 handover; those commercial terms still need confirmation against Emaar's sales documents.

https://graf.ae/launches/valia-dubai-creek-harbour/

aldar-talay-marsa-al-saadiyat:2026-09-17.body:
TALAY — FIRST VILLAS AT MARSA AL SAADIYAT

Aldar has announced 351 standalone 4–6 bedroom villas on Saadiyat Island. Sales open on 23 September 2026.

This is the first named residential release within the Marsa Al Saadiyat masterplan — a new opportunity for buyers following the island's next waterfront district.

Developer-confirmed starting prices, booking terms and handover were not included in the announcement checked.

https://graf.ae/launches/aldar-talay-marsa-al-saadiyat/

modon-wadeem-gardens:2026-09-14-broker-l.body:
WADEEM GARDENS — HUDAYRIYAT ISLAND

Broker intelligence: Modon's new villa collection is being marketed with 4, 5 and 6 bedrooms across three gated clusters.

Brokers quote prices from AED 8.7 million and a refundable AED 50,000 EOI. Advertised terms include 25/75 payments, 5% on reservation and Q2 2031 handover, with financing subject to approval. These figures are not yet independently developer-confirmed.

A new family-villa option in Abu Dhabi's major island development programme.

Image: project marketing render.
